description: This Java class 'InfoProviderFactory' provides factory methods for creating instances of ConnectionMonitor.InfoProvider, which encapsulate information extracted from ExternalMessage, Signal, or headers objects for connectivity monitoring purposes.

classes.name: InfoProviderFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing static factory methods for creating InfoProvider instances based on ExternalMessage, Signal, or header data.

methods.name: forExternalMessage
methods.description: Creates an InfoProvider using data from an ExternalMessage, including correlation ID, timestamp, headers, and payload.

methods.name: forSignal
methods.description: Creates an InfoProvider based on a Signal, extracting correlation ID, timestamp, thing ID, headers, and payload.

methods.name: forHeaders
methods.description: Creates an InfoProvider using only header data, primarily for correlation ID and timestamp.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns an InfoProvider with default or empty values, used when no specific data is available.
